entry.title: Xigia Beach
entry.summary: A small sandy and rocky cove on the north-east coast of Zakynthos, known for its sulphur springs, cloudy-turquoise water and pale cliffs. Popular with boat trips as well as visitors by road.

entry.title: Triopetra Beach
entry.summary: A long, quiet beach of sand and fine pebbles on the south coast of Crete, named for the three rock formations standing in the water. Calmer and less visited than the big north-coast resorts.

entry.title: Plage de la Gravette
entry.summary: A small sandy beach right beside the old town and port of Antibes, with calm shallow water and a walk to the ramparts.

entry.title: Praia de Santa Cruz
entry.summary: A wide Atlantic beach of golden sand with dramatic rock stacks, popular with surfers and known for its golden evening light.

entry.title: Formentor Beach
entry.summary: A sheltered bay of pale sand and shallow turquoise water at the foot of the Formentor peninsula in northern Mallorca, backed by pine trees.

entry.title: Nugal Beach
entry.summary: A small, secluded pebble cove with clear turquoise water below limestone cliffs and pines, reached on foot along a path from the Makarska coast.

entry.title: Lone Bay
entry.summary: A pebble and rock bay with clear water, shaded by pines in the Zlatni Rt forest park just south of Rovinj, with paths along the coast.

entry.title: Mingardo Beach
entry.summary: A quiet cove of small pebbles and clear water on the Cilento coast, set between green cliffs near Marina di Camerota.

entry.title: Cala Mitjana
entry.summary: A small, sheltered cove of white sand and clear turquoise water, framed by pine trees and low cliffs on the south coast of Menorca.

entry.title: Megali Ammos
entry.summary: A sandy bay a short distance from Skiathos town, with shallow, calm water and a line of tavernas along the waterfront.

entry.title: Panormos Beach
entry.summary: A sheltered bay on the west coast of Skopelos with calm water, pine-covered hills and a small strip of sand and pebbles.

entry.title: Playa de Monsul
entry.summary: A wide golden beach of fine sand backed by dunes and a striking volcanic rock, set inside the Cabo de Gata-Nijar natural park.

entry.title: Petani Beach
entry.summary: A long beach of pale sand and pebbles beneath white limestone cliffs on the west coast of the Paliki peninsula, with clear water and a relaxed atmosphere.

entry.title: Playa de Famara
entry.summary: A long, wide sandy beach on the north-west coast of Lanzarote, framed by the dramatic Famara cliffs and popular with surfers and kitesurfers.

entry.title: Praia do Beliche
entry.summary: A sheltered sandy cove near Sagres on the far south-west tip of Portugal, backed by tall cliffs and facing the open Atlantic with golden sand and clear water.

entry.title: Praia da Coelha
entry.summary: A small sandy beach on the Algarve coast near Albufeira, set below golden cliffs with clear water and a quieter feel than the main resort beaches.

entry.title: Matala Beach
entry.summary: A curved sandy bay on the south coast of Crete, overlooked by a sandstone cliff riddled with ancient caves that give the beach its unmistakable look.

entry.title: Baia delle Zagare
entry.summary: A pebble cove on the Gargano coast of Puglia, known for its white limestone sea stacks, clear turquoise water and dramatic cliffs backed by pine trees.

entry.title: Praia do Vale Figueiras
entry.summary: A quiet Atlantic beach on the west Algarve coast with golden sand, low cliffs and room to spread out away from the busier south-coast resorts.

entry.title: Piscina Rei Beach
entry.summary: A long beach of fine sand on the south-east coast of Sardinia in the municipality of Muravera, with clear water and dunes behind the shore.

entry.title: Balai Beach
entry.summary: A small pebble and sand cove on the north-west coast of Sardinia near Porto Torres, with clear water and a rocky shoreline.

entry.title: Santa Maria Beach
entry.summary: A sandy bay on the north coast of Paros near Naoussa, with clear water and a relaxed summer atmosphere.

entry.title: Golden Beach Paros
entry.summary: A long sandy beach on the east coast of Paros, open to the wind and popular with windsurfers and kitesurfers in summer.

entry.title: Lalaria Beach
entry.summary: A striking beach of smooth white pebbles beneath tall cliffs on the north coast of Skiathos, with sea arches and caves nearby. It is usually visited on a boat trip.

entry.title: Marathi Beach
entry.summary: A sandy bay beach near Chania in western Crete with clear water, rows of umbrellas and sunbeds in season, and a tree-lined backdrop.

entry.title: Praia da Bordeira
entry.summary: A wide, wild Atlantic beach on the west Algarve coast with dunes, cliffs and a shallow lagoon that forms behind the sand. A quieter alternative to the busy south-coast beaches.

entry.title: Zrce Beach
entry.summary: A long pebble beach on the island of Pag, about 2 km from Novalja, known for its beach clubs and summer music events. Mornings are calmer; evenings are lively.

entry.title: Zukovica Beach
entry.summary: A small cove on the Montenegrin coast with a narrow shore of pebbles and rocks, wooded slopes behind and clear water.

entry.title: Metalia Beach
entry.summary: A sandy beach on the island of Thassos in northern Greece, with clear water and trees behind the sand.

entry.title: Cala degli Inglesi
entry.summary: A rocky cove on San Domino in the Tremiti Islands, with clear blue water and a rugged shoreline.
